# Aaron Dsilva - CTO | AI-Native, Security-First Systems | Healthcare, E-commerce, Security

> I'm a CTO building AI-native, security-first systems. Currently co-founder of The Lean Product Studio and CTO at Aplify (multi-vendor e-commerce SaaS). Eight years shipping production systems across healthcare (hospital organizations across the US and India, FDA/HIPAA), e-commerce, and security (ISO 27001 platforms). Based in Pune, India.

I write code, architect infrastructure, lead teams, and ship products that work. I implement AI/RAG systems (Neo4j, Pinecone, Claude API) into production, fix security issues from pen tests (actual code, not reports), and build systems that pass audits: HIPAA, SOC2, GDPR, FDA, ISO 27001. As a technical partner, I've delivered systems used by teams at King's College London, Johnson & Johnson, and European hospital networks across the US, Europe, and India.

## Flagship Products

### Clinvo (https://clinvo.health)
AI-native EHR and PHR for modern clinics: ambient scribing, smart prescriptions, specialty-aware workflows. Built on a HIPAA-compliant ambient listening RAG pipeline (AWS Comprehend Medical, Claude, Neo4j). Role: technical creator. In active development.

### Aplify (https://www.aplify.in)
Multi-vendor e-commerce SaaS platform. Role: CTO. Took the platform from constant crashes to 100% uptime with a complete Flutter and Node.js rewrite, plus admin panels and real-time inventory.

### Itihaas (https://itihaas.ai)
Where tech meets heritage: 5,000 years of Indian history across 15+ interconnected categories. Role: creator.

## Expertise

### Multi-Domain Systems (10+ Production Systems)
- **Healthcare**: hospital organizations across the US and India | FDA, HIPAA, SOC2, GDPR compliance
- **E-commerce**: Multi-vendor marketplaces rebuilt from zero to 100% uptime
- **Security & SaaS**: ISO 27001 pen testing platforms, security workflow automation
- **Reliability**: 99.9% uptime, offline-first architecture, disaster recovery
- **Partner engagements**: systems used by teams at King's College London, Johnson & Johnson, and European hospital networks (delivered as a technical partner)
- **Healthcare Specialties**: HL7 FHIR, EHR integrations, clinical decision support, medical imaging

### AI & RAG Engineering (4+ Production Systems)
- **RAG Pipelines**: Pinecone (vector search), Neo4j (knowledge graphs), LangChain (orchestration)
- **LLM Integration**: Claude API, Gemini - custom healthcare models with HIPAA compliance
- **Embeddings**: HIPAA-compliant embedding generation, secure vector storage, semantic search
- **Application Layer AI**: Making healthcare apps AI-ready while maintaining security & compliance

### Security Architecture
- **Pen Test Implementation**: Fix vulnerabilities in production code—encrypted data pipelines, secure auth flows, HIPAA-compliant APIs (not just audit reports)
- **Compliance Engineering**: Implement FDA, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2, ISO 27001 standards in React Native, Node, Rails, Laravel production systems
- **Secure AI Pipelines**: Build HIPAA-compliant RAG systems—encrypted embeddings, secure vector storage in Pinecone, locked-down Neo4j graphs
- **Production Hardening**: Code disaster recovery systems, implement encrypted backups, build secure authentication flows in live healthcare apps

### Full-Stack Engineering
- **Mobile**: React Native, Flutter - offline-first, real-time sync, harsh conditions
- **Backend**: Node.js, NestJS, Laravel, Rails - API design, multi-tenancy, scalability
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Neo4j (graph), Pinecone (vector)
- **Cloud & Infrastructure**: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Aurora, S3, CloudFront, EC2, RDS)
- **Languages**: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Dart, PHP, Ruby

## Key Projects

### FDA Healthcare Platform
Led pen testing remediation, app upgrades, and security fixes—saved months of effort. Built reliably scaling AWS infrastructure with PostgreSQL RLS for secure org data isolation. Served hospital organizations across the US and India with reliable uptime.

- **Tech**: React Native, Flask, AWS, PostgreSQL (RLS)
- **Compliance**: FDA, HIPAA, SOC2, ISO 27001
- **Market**: US, India
- **Impact**: reliable uptime, saved months of security work, PostgreSQL row-level security for multi-org isolation

### AI Ambient Listening RAG Pipeline (now part of Clinvo)
Built application-layer RAG pipeline connecting to mobile app: AWS Comprehend Medical for medical entity extraction, Claude API for intelligent responses, Neo4j for medical knowledge graphs, embeddings on medical record library. HIPAA-compliant architecture with PHI data anonymization. This work now powers Clinvo (https://clinvo.health).

- **Tech**: AWS Comprehend Medical, Claude API, Neo4j, Python, React Native
- **Compliance**: HIPAA
- **Market**: US
- **Impact**: Real-time medical insights, HIPAA-compliant PHI anonymization, production RAG pipeline

### MCP Server for Healthcare Research
Built Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling healthcare researchers to access real-time analytics and database data directly without writing code or building custom solutions. Includes data visualization and query capabilities for healthcare datasets.

- **Tech**: Python, MCP, PostgreSQL, AWS
- **Compliance**: HIPAA
- **Market**: US, EU
- **Impact**: No-code data access for researchers, real-time analytics, secure healthcare data queries

### MyMami — Women's Health Platform (https://mymamiapp.com)
Rebuilt V2 from scratch in Flutter: cycle tracking, healthcare provider connections across UK and parts of Africa, self-testing workflows. Completely rewrote mobile app with multi-language support, significantly faster performance than V1.

- **Tech**: Flutter, Dart, AWS
- **Compliance**: GDPR
- **Market**: UK, Africa
- **Impact**: V2 ground-up rebuild, multi-language support, major performance improvements

### Security Testing Platform
Built web application connecting penetration testers to developers. NestJS backend on AWS for secure testing communication, regression tracking, and centralized security reporting. Streamlines security fix workflows and compliance tracking.

- **Tech**: NestJS, PostgreSQL, AWS, React
- **Compliance**: ISO 27001
- **Market**: Global
- **Impact**: Centralized security workflow, regression tracking, faster pen test remediation

### Aplify — Multi-Vendor Marketplace V2 (https://www.aplify.in)
Rebuilt from scratch using Flutter + Node.js + MongoDB: platform with advertisements, auctions, carpool features, and real-time chat. Fixed constant server downtime issues and completely broken UI/UX flows. Achieved 100% uptime, optimized UI, reduced bugs, built comprehensive admin panels. Now serving as CTO.

- **Tech**: Flutter, Node.js, MongoDB, AWS
- **Market**: India
- **Impact**: V2 from scratch, fixed server downtime (now 100% uptime), rebuilt broken UI/UX, admin panels
